pages.text: Addendum for $(l:structures/alteration_site)$(c)$(o)Alteration Sites$().$(br)$(br)Honestly speaking, Lovers are genuinely my favorite. They are great specimens to use for experiments as they can be leashed, they float - meaning they can traverse any type of terrain - and pose virtually no direct danger. They even like flowers! I would definitely prefer keeping a Lover as a pet over any other monster. Even if its looks are horrendous, I can just get used to it with time. No issues!

$(o)Note: Re-reading this addendum, I realize it comes across sounding a bit insane despite any such intentions. It was simply written right after the frustration of a Holder stealing an item of mine again, so I inadvertently included more unfiltered emotions than I should have.
